arxiv-2012-04072.title: Microscopic mechanism of unusual lattice thermal transport in TlInTe 2
arxiv-2012-04072.creator: Koushik Pal, Yi Xia, Chris Wolverton
arxiv-2012-04072.description: Abstract We investigate the microscopic mechanism of ultralow lattice thermal conductivity ( κ l \kappa_{l} ) of TlInTe 2 and its weak temperature dependence using a unified theory of lattice heat transport that considers contributions arising from the particle-like propagation as well as wave-like tunneling of phonons.

arxiv-2309-03913.title: A Robust Adaptive Workload Orchestration in Pure Edge Computing
arxiv-2309-03913.creator: Zahra Safavifar 1 , Charafeddine Mechalikh 2 and Fatemeh Golpayegani 1 1 University College Dublin, School of Computer Science, Ireland 2 Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (LINATI), University Kasdi Merbah, Ouargla, Algeria zahra.safavifar@ucdconnect.ie, mechalikh.char
arxiv-2309-03913.description: Abstract Pure Edge computing (PEC) aims to bring cloud applications and services to the edge of the network to support the growing user demand for time-sensitive applications and data-driven computing. However, mobility and limited computational capacity of edge devices pose challenges in supporting some urgent and computationally intensive tasks with strict response time demands.

arxiv-2309-13426.title: A Chat About Boring Problems: Studying GPT-based text normalization
arxiv-2309-13426.creator: Yang Zhang *, Travis M. Bartley † \sthanks Equal contribution, Mariana Graterol-Fuenmayor, Vitaly Lavrukhin, Evelina Bakhturina, Boris Ginsburg
arxiv-2309-13426.description: Abstract Text normalization - the conversion of text from written to spoken form - is traditionally assumed to be an ill-formed task for language modeling. In this work, we argue otherwise. We empirically show the capacity of Large-Language Models (LLM) for text normalization in few-shot scenarios.

arxiv-2404-16089.title: Observational Parameters of Blue Large-amplitude Pulsators
arxiv-2404-16089.creator: Paweł Pietrukowicz, Marilyn Latour, Igor Soszyński, Francesco Di Mille, Piera Soto King, Rodolfo Angeloni, Radosław Poleski, Andrzej Udalski, Michał K. Szymański, Krzysztof Ulaczyk, Szymon Kozłowski, Jan Skowron, Dorota M. Skowron, Przemek Mróz, Krzysztof Rybicki, Patryk Iwanek, Marcin Wrona, Marius
arxiv-2404-16089.description: Abstract Blue large-amplitude pulsators (BLAPs) are a recently discovered class of short-period pulsating variable stars. In this work, we present new information on these stars based on photometric and spectroscopic data obtained for known and new objects detected by the Optical Gravitational Lensing Experiment (OGLE) survey.

arxiv-2409-12484.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Michael Kompatscher, Peter Mayr. A basic fact taught in undergraduate algebra courses is that every finite nilpotent group is a direct product of p p -groups. Already Bruck [ 5 ] observed that this does not generalize to loops. pmc-12430182.title: Hydrojet Surface Treatment of Ti-6Al-4V Titanium Produced by Additive Manufacturing
pmc-12430182.creator: Monika Szada-Borzyszkowska, Dorota Laskowska, Błażej Bałasz, Wiesław Szada-Borzyszkowski
pmc-12430182.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The aim of this study was to analyze the effect of finishing methods on the surface quality of Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy additively manufactured by selective laser melting. It was observed that among the finishing methods, water jet treatment did not produce significant changes, while the abrasive water jet proved effective in removing defects and smoothing the surface, especially at a pressure of 30 MPa. However, the risk of abrasive particle entrapment in the material was observed.

pmc-12831457.title: Clinical characteristics of patients who attempt suicide by drug overdose in Western China: a retrospective analysis
pmc-12831457.creator: Lingyan Li, Huaiyi Zhu, Lin Wang, Zuolin Wei, Xiaoli Wang, Yigang Li, Mingjin Huang
pmc-12831457.description: BackgroundOverdose is a prevalent method of suicide, and a thorough analysis of the demographic characteristics and risk behaviour patterns within the drug overdose population might facilitate the development of effective treatments and prevention methods.MethodsThis retrospective study analysed patients hospitalized for attempted suicide by drug overdose (2020–2023) at a tertiary care hospital in Western China.

pmc-12981659.creator: Farhad Bakhtiary, Peter Benedikt, Nikolaos Bonaros, Michael Borger, Mirko Doss, Richard Feyrer, Jürg Grünenfelder, Tamer Owais, Seymur Karimli, Ka Yan Lam, Andreas Liebold, Andreas Martens, Parwis Massoudy, Islam Batashev, Jochen Pöling, Maximilian Philipp Scherner, Justus Strauch, Matthias Thielman

After 3 years, haemodynamic performance, all-cause mortality, and valve-related mortality were determined.

pmc-13179190.title: Changes in Functional Capacity and Body Composition After a Multimodal Prehabilitation Program in Patients with Cancer undergoing Abdominal Surgery
pmc-13179190.creator: Luuk D Drager, Baukje van den Heuvel, Dieuwke Strijker, Cornelis J H M van Laarhoven, Laurien M Buffart, Sjors Verlaan
pmc-13179190.description: BackgroundPreoperative functional capacity and body composition are associated with postoperative outcomes in patients undergoing abdominal surgery for cancer. Long-term effects of multimodal prehabilitation and exercise dose–response associations remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate changes in functional capacity and body composition during and after prehabilitation and evaluate exercise dose–response associations.

pmc-13374825.title: Protracted Febrile Myalgia Syndrome as Initial Presentation of Familial Mediterranean Fever in a Patient of Northern European Extraction Thought to have Ulcerative Colitis
pmc-13374825.creator: Stephanie Ammari, Daniel Stein, Nawras Ibrahim
pmc-13374825.description: IntroductionProtracted febrile myalgia syndrome is a rare vasculitic manifestation of familial Mediterranean fever that presents as the initial familial Mediterranean fever manifestation in one-third of cases. While familial Mediterranean fever is classically autosomal recessive and associated with Mediterranean ancestry, the p.Met694del variant demonstrates autosomal dominant inheritance with a Northern European founder effect.

pmc-13438802.title: NanoBiT screening identifies the azaoxafluorene VT11 as potent tau interaction inhibitor
pmc-13438802.creator: Niya Ma, Jens Stieler, Isabel Hilbrich, Tim Vogel, Andreas Hilgeroth, Detlef Briel, Michael Schaefer, Max Holzer, Moritz Metelmann
pmc-13438802.description: Tauopathies are neurodegenerative disorders characterized by accumulating misfolded, insoluble tau protein aggregates in neurons or glial cells. In this study, we screened the Spectrum Collection and other compound libraries for inhibitors of tau self-interaction using a structural complementation reporter system (NanoLuciferase Binary Technology). Resulting candidates were tested in dose-response assays and evaluated for cell toxicity and microtubule destabilization.

pmc-13543270.title: HARKing, transparency, and honesty in reporting: improving reporting of scientific articles
pmc-13543270.creator: Aleksi Reito, Robin Christensen, Soren Overgaard

With these analytical opportunities and flexibilities in observational data come a recurring methodological problem known as HARKing, short for hypothesizing after the results are known [1]. HARKing compromises transparency, inflates apparent evidential support for findings, and contributes to potentially misleading conclusions.
